How we help

Business process improvement

Map how work really happens today, find where time and money leak out, and redesign it using Lean Six Sigma methods that your team can sustain.

BA team training

Build business analysis capability inside your organisation, taught through your own projects: requirements, process modelling, stakeholders and prioritisation.

AI adoption workshops

Hands-on workshops that help BA, delivery and operations teams use AI tools well and safely: shared ways of working, safe-use guidelines and practice on your own processes. More on AI for BAs

Transformation consultancy

Hands-on business analysis for digital transformation: discovery, requirements, vendor evaluation and making sure the change lands with the people who use it.

Experience you can check

Thirteen years leading business analysis across thirteen markets in telecoms, real estate and the public sector, including HR transformation, workflow automation and productivity tracking at IHS Towers, and work with Renascence CX, The Rock Tower and HOTR London.

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, ITIL 4 and ISEB Business Analysis certified, with an MSc in Software Technology.

Common questions

What kinds of organisations do you work with?

Organisations that want to improve processes, build business analysis capability in their teams, or run digital transformation that delivers results. Past work spans telecoms, real estate and the public sector in the UAE, UK and other markets.

Can you train our existing business analysts?

Yes. Team training is built around your real projects, covering requirements, process modelling, stakeholder management and prioritisation.

How does an engagement start?

With a free consultation to understand the problem, the people involved and what a good outcome looks like. From there we agree a scope that fits.
